pkgmetadata.longdescription: Collection of Triton kernels for efficient LLM training: fused RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU/GeGLU and FusedLinearCrossEntropy that avoids materializing full logits, cutting peak GPU memory on large-vocab models. Integrates with HuggingFace transformers via monkey-patching or TrainingArguments(use_liger_kernel=True).
